Updates `webpack` from 5.111.1 to 5.112.0
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">webpack's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>v5.112.0</h2>
<h3>Minor Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Apply <code>plugins</code> set on a multi-configuration array to the <code>MultiCompiler</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22702</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>optimization.minimize.css.dropOverriddenDeclarations</code>, dropping a declaration a later one overrides where no target is named. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22175</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Export more plugins under their scope, move eleven loose exports under theirs, deprecate the old, and expose <code>template.DependencyTemplate</code>, <code>module.NullFactory</code> and <code>util.makeSerializable</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22261</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Let <code>util.makeSerializable</code> take several requests, current one first. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22340</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Emit the source map <code>scopes</code> field, so a debugger resolves imported ESM bindings by name. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21999</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>library.entryExports: &quot;all&quot;</code> to expose the exports of every entry module. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22235</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Recognize a required <code>const</code> binding assigned to <code>exports</code> as a re-export. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​hai-x</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22276</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Accept glob patterns in more path, module and file filter options. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​hai-x</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22422</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Bundle a run of inline <code>&lt;script&gt;</code> tags into one chunk the page can inline. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22188</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>module.parser.javascript.topLevelThis</code> for classic-script <code>this</code> semantics. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22193</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>module.parser.html.chunkName</code> and a <code>webpackChunkName</code> comment for tags. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22200</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>include</code>/<code>exclude</code> version and request filters to shared modules. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22297</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Keep module side-effect information in ESM output as PURE annotations. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21789</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>optimization.splitChunks.dedupDepth</code> to discover chunk intersections. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22240</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>optimization.minimizeOptions.json</code>, on by default with <code>futureDefaults</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22286</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>SSRManifestPlugin</code> and fix server-rendered CSS collection and adoption. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#21913</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add an <code>ignore</code> hook to <code>output.copy</code> and keep unfollowed <code>from</code> symlinks. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22216</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add <code>optimization.minimize.css.convertApproximateColors</code>. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22157</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add XML parsing and SVG/XML minification with data URLs and attribute sorting. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22269</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Extract CSS/HTML license comments like JS and safely shorten CSS gradients. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22408</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Resolve an async <code>DefinePlugin.runtimeValue</code> over an async <code>beforeParse</code> hook. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22210</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add CSS <code>customMedia</code>/<code>customSelectors</code> minimize options; resolve chained names. (by <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]"><code>@​alexander-akait</code></a> in <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: redirect.github.com]">#22360</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
